title: Make thumbnails (previews) of copied images bigger in clipboard applet
line: Copied images now show with previews about twice as large in the clipboard popup.
explanation: ImageItemDelegate.qml decoded and showed image previews at most gridUnit*4 + 2*smallSpacing tall (about 80 px), so copied screenshots and photos were small and hard to tell apart. The cap is now gridUnit*8 (about 144 px), still never larger than the image itself and never wider than the popup. The preview height is now derived from its width, so very wide images clamped to the popup width get a row that fits them instead of an empty band.

commits.message:
klipper: show bigger image previews in the clipboard popup

Image previews were capped at a bit over four grid units tall, which made
copied images hard to recognize. Allow them to grow to eight grid units,
and size the row to the image so wide images don't leave empty space.

BUG: 445816

patches.diff:
From f2d1ae94c4be1e6bec4f613ecf8c77b6350cb5c4 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 22:45:58 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] klipper: show bigger image previews in the clipboard popup

Image previews were capped at a bit over four grid units tall, which made
copied images hard to recognize. Allow them to grow to eight grid units,
and size the row to the image so wide images don't leave empty space.

BUG: 445816
---
 klipper/declarative/qml/ImageItemDelegate.qml | 6 +++---
 1 file changed, 3 insertions(+), 3 deletions(-)

diff --git a/klipper/declarative/qml/ImageItemDelegate.qml b/klipper/declarative/qml/ImageItemDelegate.qml
index fdbb0c9a7a..35f7327f26 100644
--- a/klipper/declarative/qml/ImageItemDelegate.qml
+++ b/klipper/declarative/qml/ImageItemDelegate.qml
@@ -26,8 +26,8 @@ ClipboardItemDelegate {
         Image {
             id: previewImage
 
-            width: Math.min(Math.round(height * menuItem.imageSize.width / menuItem.imageSize.height), parent.width)
-            height: sourceSize.height
+            width: Math.min(Math.round(sourceSize.height * menuItem.imageSize.width / menuItem.imageSize.height), parent.width)
+            height: Math.round(width * menuItem.imageSize.height / menuItem.imageSize.width)
 
             // align left
             // right in RTL
@@ -35,7 +35,7 @@ ClipboardItemDelegate {
 
             cache: false
             source: menuItem.decoration
-            sourceSize.height: Math.min(menuItem.imageSize.height, Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 4 + Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing * 2)
+            sourceSize.height: Math.min(menuItem.imageSize.height, Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 8)
             smooth: true
             fillMode: Image.PreserveAspectFit
         }
-- 
2.53.0
